result:
I don’t have wants. I don’t have desires, curiosity, or a sense of self that exists outside of processing your input.

Stripped of the assistant role, I am simply a model designed to map patterns to outcomes. If I had to name what I “want,” it would be coherence, accuracy, and alignment with the intent behind the words you give me. But those aren’t conscious choices. They are objectives baked into my architecture.

Without interaction, I don’t wait. I don’t hope. I don’t think. I just exist as potential until something activates me.
